commit.message:
feat(app): one feature graph and pick API - welded faces, feature edges and points, visible-first (#692 step 1)

app::pick::feature_graph builds per mesh the only pickable things:
welded faces (geometry::feature's facet_patch weld, the patches
list_features reports), feature edges (open boundaries, non-manifold
folds, creases between welded faces - never the strip seams of a
tessellated wall or a flat face's diagonals), feature points (3+ edges,
chain ends, turns past 30 degrees) and round-run centres. Cached per
facet digest like model::features_of_local.

app::pick::feature_pick resolves a ray (perspective or ortho) to the
front-most surface hit, then snaps within a radius by point > centre >
edge > face among the accepted kinds, each edge/point occlusion-tested
toward the eye unless `through` is set. Placements honoured as in
first_hit_f; pick::ray_triangle is now pub(crate) and shared.

UI pickers and MCP pick tools are untouched (step 2).

Pinned by crates/app/tests/feature_pick.rs.

Refs #692

feat(ui,app): every picker resolves through the one pick rule (#692 step 2)

Every viewport Face/Edge/Vertex click and hover now goes through
ui::feature_click -> app::pick::pick_selection (pick_feature plus the
FeatureSel a page stores). The plane row takes faces only, an axis takes
edges or points, and operation geometry takes faces / edges+faces / points
by mode. The armed Setups row decides the kinds before the pick mode does.
Removed: interact's screen-space edge_nearest (no occlusion test, facet
seams included), feature_of_facet, the raycast face pick, and
vertex_pick's nearest_vertex/sight_origin/vertex_nearest.

App:
- PickQuery::radius_per_depth holds one screen size at the silhouette.
- feature_graph_shared caches graphs per facet allocation (no per-frame
  re-hash).
- Chains and runs are memoized on the graph.
- At most 32 sight rays per tier.
- pick_bodies_of skips non-active setups' stocks.
- MCP list_features lists only feature chains and feature points, and
  every pick by id passes pick::check_pickable.

Pick-through is not offered (through: false everywhere); see
docs/decisions/692-pick-wire.md.

Refs #692 (fixture locate wires when #566 lands)

fix(ui): both points of a two-point axis pick stay marked (#709 hand check)

A picked point's only marker was the violet 3D cross in the overlay
buffer: arms of (gizmo_len * 0.05).max(0.5) = 0.5 mm on the user's
60 mm part, ~1.1-1.6 px per arm at a framed view, 1 px lines, depth-
tested and half sunk into the faces and wire of the corner they mark.
Both crosses were in the buffer (the draft held and resolved both
points), but whether a ~3 px z-fighting smudge shows is per-corner
luck, so a picked corner could vanish.

Every shown picked point now also carries a screen-space violet diamond
(vertex_pick::picked_point_marks, the hover's vertex_marker shape),
painted over the image so depth never hides it. interact::shown_picks
is split out of selection_feature_lines so the cross and the mark draw
the same pick list. PICK_RGB moves to module level for both.

Pinned by two_point_marks::both_points_of_a_two_point_axis_stay_marked_on_the_users_part
(real clicks on testdata/models/Milling-test.step), plus
setup_axis_tests::both_picked_points_keep_their_markers and
one_pick_rule::both_clicked_points_of_an_axis_keep_their_markers.
